scope: A native state-vector realization of the IBM-056 single-site syndrome instrument. Nine Shor data wires and eight initially zero syndrome wires are present simultaneously. Two additional wires hold an entangled reference and a channel environment.
checks: Measure the six neighboring ZZ pairs within blocks, followed by the two six-qubit X products between adjacent blocks. Compare the full coherent premeasurement state with the Pauli expansion of each Kraus operator. Measure all eight syndrome bits and compare each normalized branch before and after recovery. Corrections depend only on the syndrome. Recovered vectors may have one overall phase per classical outcome.
channels: S Ry(0.73) followed by a Z with probability sin(0.55)^2, retaining a coherent environment flag
scope_limit: These are finite single-site channels in the numerical circuit core. The dense symbolic instrument API still has its earlier dimension limit.
